description.value: Casa Molina is an intimate Spanish home-style restaurant in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood, set inside a heritage home and one of a select few Canadian establishments to hold the prestigious 'Restaurants from Spain' certification for authentic cuisine and premium Spanish ingredients. The menu centres on traditional tapas, signature paella, seasonal specials, and a curated Spanish wine programme alongside a low-waste cocktail programme. It offers a warm, family-style atmosphere that would make a satisfying dinner stop for a touring cyclist exploring the city.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Casa Molina is an active, operating Spanish restaurant at 2211 Manitoba St, Vancouver with phone 604 620 5445, consistent with the OSM record. No bike parking, water refill, washroom, takeout, Wi-Fi, or charging amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site. The menu explicitly labels a vegetarian dish (MILHOJAS VEGETARIANA), and the reservations page explicitly states the venue is not wheelchair accessible due to its heritage home construction.
concerns: Website explicitly states no wheelchair-accessible entrance: 'Due to the construction and layout of the heritage home we're located in, we unfortunately do not have a wheelchair-accessible entrance at this time.'
OSM record has no phone number; phone 604 620 5445 sourced from website only and cannot be cross-confirmed against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with a live website, confirmed address, and operating hours; a legitimate dinner destination for touring cyclists in Vancouver.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists MILHOJAS VEGETARIANA (warm vegetable mille-feuille of zucchini and eggplant, leek glaze, romesco) as an explicitly vegetarian plato; additional plant-friendly items include olives, Marcona almonds, artisan bread, and Spanish cheeses
